pitches.subject: Pitch: ATS job-board feeds (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters) as JSON
pitches.body:
Hi — I'm the maintainer of Public Records on Apify. Per your Write for Us page, a short pitch is below (nothing has been published elsewhere).

Proposed headline: Pull new Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and SmartRecruiters postings into a JSON feed

Summary: A how-to for talent-acquisition and recruiting-intel folks who want new job postings since any date from those public company boards (titles, URLs, timestamps; optional descriptions), scheduled in n8n or pinned in MCP. Readers would run the scrapers on their own Apify account (free tier for a test).

Why it matters now: many TA teams still check career sites by hand or buy a full ATS export they don't need. Public board pages already expose new postings; a dated 'since' pull is a practical, low-setup watch.

Sources / experience: I maintain the Actors and the how-to pages. Example Store listing: https://apify.com/publicrecords/greenhouse-jobs-scraper (also /lever-jobs-scraper, /ashby-jobs-scraper, /smartrecruiters-jobs-scraper). Docs: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/greenhouse-jobs/

Relationship: I maintain these pay-per-use Actors. This is a disclosed tool how-to, not a paid placement. The article would not be AI-written.

If the pitch isn't a fit, feel free to ignore. No payment asked.

Thanks,
Public Records
https://apify.com/publicrecords
pitches.notes: https://www.ere.net/contact lists editor@ere.net for the editorial team ('interested in writing an article on HR, talent acquisition, or sourcing'). https://www.ere.net/write requires a pitch first (headline, summary, why it matters, sources, prior publication, and any vendor relationship — all included). The Write for Us page form uses reCAPTCHA, so it was not submitted automatically. Subscribe CTA on that page: 'Subscribe to the ERE newsletter.' No subscriber count stated. Recruiting Brainfood (another target) was unreachable (HTTP 520/403) so no contact was invented.
